lines.beaver: 민지야, 무슨 소식 들었어? 표정이 되게 밝다.
lines.beaver_en: Minji, did you hear some news? You look really happy.
lines.beaver_roman: Minjiya, museun sosik deureosseo? Pyojeongi doege bakda.
lines.learner: 수아가 다음 달에 결혼한다는 소식을 들었어.
lines.en: I heard the news that Sua is getting married next month.
lines.roman: Suaga daeum dare gyeolhonhandaneun sosigeul deureosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? I did hear she got engaged!
lines.learner: 응, 작년 겨울에 약혼했다는 말은 나도 들었어.
lines.en: Yeah, I also heard she got engaged last winter.
lines.roman: Eung, jangnyeon gyeoure yakonhaetdaneun mareun nado deureosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Did they pick a wedding venue?
lines.learner: 강남에 있는 결혼식장으로 정했다는 연락이 왔어.
lines.en: I got a message that they chose a venue in Gangnam.
lines.roman: Gangname inneun gyeolhonsikjangeuro jeonghaetdaneun yeollagi wasseo.

lines.learner: 오 년 동안 연애했다는 얘기를 들었어.
lines.en: I heard they dated for five years.
lines.roman: O nyeon dongan yeonaehaetdaneun yaegireul deureosseo.

lines.beaver: 와, 오래 만났네. 미혼 친구들이 부러워하겠다.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's long. Our single friends must be jealous.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, orae mannanne. Mihon chingudeuri bureowohagetda.
lines.learner: 맞아. 미혼인 친구들이 다 부럽다는 말을 했어.
lines.en: Right. All our single friends said they're jealous.
lines.roman: Maja. Mihonin chingudeuri da bureopdaneun mareul haesseo.

lines.beaver: 우리 중에 결혼한 친구는 이제 몇 명이야?
lines.beaver_en: How many of our friends are married now?
lines.beaver_roman: Uri junge gyeolhonhan chinguneun ije myeon myeongiya?
lines.learner: 수아까지 하면 기혼인 친구가 세 명이야.
lines.en: Counting Sua, three of our friends are married.
lines.roman: Suakkaji hamyeon gihonin chinguga se myeongiya.

lines.beaver_en: What's the person Sua's marrying like?
lines.en: They say the guy she's marrying is really kind.

lines.beaver_en: That's good. Lots of people get divorced these days.
lines.learner: 그래도 둘은 이혼 걱정은 없다는 느낌이 들어.
lines.en: Still, I feel like those two won't need to worry about divorce.
lines.roman: Geuraedo dureun ihon geokjeongeun eopdaneun neukkimi deureo.

lines.learner: 응. 나도 결혼하고 싶다는 생각이 들었어.
lines.en: Yeah. It made me think I want to get married too.
lines.roman: Eung. Nado gyeolhonhago sipdaneun saenggagi deureosseo.

lines.beaver: 너도 곧 좋은 사람 만날 거야!
lines.beaver_en: You'll meet someone great soon too!
lines.beaver_roman: Neodo got joeun saram mannal geoya!
